title: Grade screening units inside bubblewrap so third-party code cannot reach the desktop
body:
Source: t-tpkc9xz trial (d), .krn/runs/research/rss-trials/d.md
Outcome: run() in evals/units/screening.ts wraps install (network on) and test (network off) in bwrap --unshare-all --ro-bind / / --tmpfs /run --tmpfs /tmp --clearenv with only the scratch bound writable; a missing bwrap is a refusal, not an unsandboxed run. Replaces the PATH-stub plan in t-nsk5wca and covers token isolation of t-k7gv1wt for grading.
Proof: node --test test/evals/screening-units.test.ts runs `xdg-open https://example.invalid; env` in the wrapper and asserts no DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY/DBUS/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/GH_TOKEN, `ls /run/user` fails, and the t-fd481gz base/fix verdicts equal {1,0}.
